title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_live_rfq_lists_invited_vendor_without_bid
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no bids yet. The buyer only reads the reminder list.
steps: 1. As the event's buyer, open the reminder list for the event (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: HTTP 200. Offer submissions lists exactly one vendor (QA vendor 1) with the RFQ round under 'Bid Pending For', no last-reminded time and remindable (can_remind true); pending evaluations, counter offers, best offer, cost breakdown and auction reminders are null; approvals null unless the company has a pending approval on the event.
rationale: The drawer's main use is chasing vendors who have not quoted; an error or empty list here means the feature is dead.

assert.say: one vendor is pending an offer
the pending vendor is QA vendor 1

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_vendor_who_bid_drops_out
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has submitted a bid; bidding still open. Read only.
steps: 1. As the buyer, read the reminder list (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: HTTP 200. QA vendor 1 is no longer pending, so offer submissions is null (vendor 1 is in the round's bid_company_ids once its bid is active, app/models/bid.rb:507-508); nothing else pending.
rationale: Reminding a vendor who already quoted is noise; the list must subtract vendors who have bid.

assert.say: no vendor is pending an offer once QA vendor 1 has bid

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_closed_round_is_empty
preconditions: QA vendor 1 bid; the bidding window and extra closing time are over. Read only.
steps: 1. As the buyer, read the reminder list (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with body null: no round has its closing time in the future, so get_reminder_data returns nil (the drawer shows 'No Pending Actions to Remind'). Never a 5xx.
rationale: Only rounds still open may be offered for reminders; a closed event must answer cleanly.

assert.say: nothing to remind after the close (body null)

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_draft_event_is_empty
preconditions: A draft event with an unpublished RFQ round; the caller is its owner. Read only.
steps: 1. As the owner, read the reminder list (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with body null: the owner passes the view check, but the reminder service only loads live (active) events, so it returns nil.
rationale: A draft must answer cleanly, not crash on rounds that have no live schedule.

assert.say: nothing to remind on a draft (body null)

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_unknown_event_should_not_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; no event needed.
steps: 1. Read the reminder list for an event id that decodes to 999999999 (GET /reminders/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly (404 or 422). Today EventGroup.find_by returns nil and authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError, which is not rescued (only NotAuthorizedError is, api_auth.rb:16) -> HTTP 500. A 500 here is the defect.
rationale: An unknown event id must never be a server error.

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_garbled_event_id_should_not_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; no event needed.
steps: 1. Read the reminder list with an id that decodes to nothing (GET /reminders/WrongUuid1=?resource_type=event_group).
expectedResult: Should be a clean 4xx. Today the id decodes to nil, EventGroup.find_by(id: nil) is nil and authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: The most common shape of a broken link must not crash the server.

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_unknown_resource_type_answers_error_as_success
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Read only.
steps: 1. Read the reminder list with resource type 'trade_request' (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=trade_request).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": "Reminders does not exist"} and no permission check at all (authorize_resource and reminder_service_for only know event_group). Should be a 422; suspected defect: an error reported with a success status. A 5xx would be a new defect.
rationale: Records today's behaviour; catches a regression to a crash and documents the missing authorisation for unknown types.

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_missing_resource_type_answers_error_as_success
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Read only.
steps: 1. Read the reminder list without a resource type (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": "Reminders does not exist"}. Should be 422 code 2 'Insufficient parameters'.
rationale: A client that forgets the type should get a parameter error, not a success.

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_resource_type_is_case_sensitive
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Read only.
steps: 1. Read the reminder list with resource type 'EVENT_GROUP' (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type=EVENT_GROUP).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": "Reminders does not exist"} — :EVENT_GROUP is not :event_group, so no lookup and no authorisation.
rationale: Documents the case-sensitive type and the unauthenticated fallthrough.

title: QA_Platform_reminder_list_resource_type_as_list_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Read only (the crash happens before any lookup).
steps: 1. Read the reminder list with the resource type sent as a list (GET /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}?resource_type[]=event_group).
expectedResult: Should be a clean 422. Today resource_type is an Array and authorize_resource calls to_sym on it -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Any client can trigger this crash with one query parameter.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_without_map_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Nothing can be written or emailed: the crash is on controller line 18, before the service, the permission check or any email.
steps: 1. Send a reminder request with no 'reminders' map (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2 'Insufficient parameters'. Today params[:reminders] is nil and nil.to_unsafe_h raises NoMethodError (the '|| {}' fallback is never reached) -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: A missing required field must be a validation message, not a server error.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_map_as_text_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Crashes on controller line 18, before anything else.
steps: 1. Send a reminder request whose 'reminders' is a text value (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422. Today String#to_unsafe_h -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Hostile shape of the one required map.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_map_as_list_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Crashes on controller line 18, before anything else.
steps: 1. Send a reminder request whose 'reminders' is a list (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422. Today Array#to_unsafe_h -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Sending recipients as a list is a natural client mistake.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_unknown_event_should_not_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; no event. The service is built (finds nothing), then the permission check is handed nil and raises — before the service's send, so no row and no email.
steps: 1. Send a reminder for an event id that decodes to 999999999 (POST /reminders/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==/send_reminder) with an unknown vendor and round.
expectedResult: Should be a clean 4xx. Today EventGroup.find_by returns nil and authorize(nil, :update?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError (not rescued) -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: An unknown event must never be a server error.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_garbled_event_id_should_not_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; no event. Crashes at the permission check, before the send.
steps: 1. Send a reminder with an event id that decodes to nothing (POST /reminders/WrongUuid1=/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be a clean 4xx. Today id nil -> EventGroup.find_by nil -> authorize(nil, :update?) -> Pundit::NotDefinedError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Broken links must not crash the server.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_unknown_resource_type_answers_empty_success
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. With an unknown type no service is built, nothing is looked up or sent.
steps: 1. Send a reminder with resource type 'trade_request' (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body null (the controller renders an unassigned 'data'); no permission check. Should be a 422. A 5xx would be a new defect.
rationale: Documents a success status for a request that did nothing.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_on_draft_answers_error_inside_success
preconditions: A draft RFQ; the caller is its owner. The owner passes the permission check; the service returns on line 35 (no live event) before the map is read, any reminder row is written or any email is queued.
steps: 1. Send an offer-submission reminder on the draft event (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder) with an unknown vendor and round.
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": true, "code": 533} (533 = 'Project does not exist.'). Should be HTTP 422 with code 533 and its message; suspected defect: an error with a success status.
rationale: Callers trusting the status think the reminder went out.

title: QA_Platform_send_auction_reminder_without_auction_answers_error_inside_success
preconditions: A live RFQ-only event (no auction), QA vendor 1 invited. The map names QA vendor 1 and the RFQ round; the service finds no auction stage and returns on line 62, BEFORE create_reminder_records (line 68) and send_reminder_email (line 69) — nothing is written or emailed.
steps: 1. Send an auction reminder for QA vendor 1 and the RFQ round (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": true, "code": 533} — 533 means 'Project does not exist.', the wrong meaning here. Should be a 422 saying there is no auction to remind about.
rationale: Documents the error-as-success reply and guards that no reminder is written when no auction is found.

title: QA_Platform_send_auction_reminder_unknown_ids_after_close_answers_error_inside_success
preconditions: A closed RFQ with a bid. Unknown round ids resolve to nothing, so no auction is found; the service returns on line 62 before any write or email.
steps: 1. Send an auction reminder with an unknown vendor and round (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Expected (today): HTTP 200 with body {"error": true, "code": 533}.
rationale: Same early return on a closed event; catches a regression into a crash.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_without_kind_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer (caller passes the permission check). The map uses unknown ids; the crash is inside the reminder-row builder (base_service.rb:40), BEFORE Reminder.insert_all (line 54) and before the email (event_group_service.rb:69) — nothing written or sent.
steps: 1. Send a reminder with no reminder kind (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2 'Insufficient parameters'. Today nil.singularize raises NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: The reminder kind is never validated.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_numeric_kind_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ of the QA buyer. Crash at base_service.rb:40, before the insert and the email.
steps: 1. Send a reminder whose kind is the number 5 (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422. Today Integer#singularize -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Same unvalidated field, a different hostile type.

title: QA_Platform_send_reminder_round_list_as_text_should_not_crash
preconditions: A live RFQ; caller is the owner (passes the permission check). Crash on event_group_service.rb:38, before any row or email.
steps: 1. Send a reminder whose vendor entry holds a single text id instead of a list (POST /reminders/{{eventGroupUuid}}/send_reminder).
expectedResult: Should be 422. Today String#map -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 (the defect).
rationale: Each map value must be a list; a single id is an easy client mistake.
